name: Kei☆Ten
source:
An all-ages mahjong game for beginners and experienced players alike. In the kaibutsu world, the student council president declared that the fate of the light music club will be settled by playing mahjong! However, they don’t know how to play.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/08/01/august-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一款适合新手与老玩家的全年龄麻将游戏。在怪物世界里，学生会长宣布，轻音部的命运将由麻将对局决定！然而，部员们根本不会打麻将。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/08/01/august-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
